Database connection closed together with the session

Source: R/helpers.R
aa_session_connection.Rd

Opens a database connection and immediately registers its closing when the Shiny session ends. Without this the connection stays open until the R process stops and holds the database file (SQLite, DuckDB): on Windows such a file cannot be renamed or deleted, and server databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) are left with extra connections.

Usage

aa_session_connection(
  db_path = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain(),
  prepare = FALSE,
  settings = aa_settings(),
  connect = NULL
)

Arguments

db_path

Path to the SQLite database file. Not needed if connect is set.

session

Shiny session. The current one by default, so the function must be called inside server.

prepare

Prepare the database schema (aa_prepare_db()) right after connecting.

settings

Settings, a result of aa_settings(), needed for prepare.

connect

A function without arguments that returns a database connection (SQLite, DuckDB, MySQL / MariaDB or PostgreSQL), or NULL for a SQLite file.

Value

A database connection.

Details

By default a SQLite file is opened. For another database pass connect: a function without arguments that returns a DBI connection.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # SQLite (default)
  conn <- aa_session_connection("app.db", prepare = TRUE)

  # MySQL / MariaDB
  conn <- aa_session_connection(
    prepare = TRUE,
    connect = function() DBI::dbConnect(
      RMariaDB::MariaDB(), host = "db.example.com", dbname = "app",
      user = "app", password = Sys.getenv("APP_DB_PASSWORD")
    )
  )

  auth <- aa_auth_server("auth", conn)
}
} # }
